about_the_game:
This is a map-grinding and level-passing game with a top - down perspective as its core gameplay. Players will act as adventurers who collect skill points by grinding monsters and exploring. Use the skill point system to gradually unlock, upgrade skills and strengthen character attributes, and finally challenge high - difficulty levels and bosses. The game combines action combat and map exploration elements. Players need to flexibly use skill combinations to deal with various enemies and unlock levels by completing specific tasks.

Game Background

In 7077 AD, the comet "Purple Cloud" tore through the atmosphere, and the strange virus it carried pushed the Earth to the edge of chaos. Humanity eked out a living between the rampaging infected beasts and deformed machines, while the only glimmer of hope was hidden in the guidance of an ancient East Asian proverb - "Where the poison is transported, there must be a solution."

Gameplay

Enjoy the fun of grinding maps and challenge all kinds of monsters

The game has set up multiple map levels, and each map level corresponds to different monsters and skill playstyles.

Rich Skill Combinations

The game contains a skill tree system. Players can collect various skill points by exploring and defeating enemies. Various skills can be learned by using the corresponding skill points.

Numerous Boss Challenges

The game has set numerous bosses. Each boss has different characteristics and skill combinations, and requires strong firepower or skill combinations to be successfully challenged.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains combat scenes, and when enemies are hit, there will be a blood - splashing effect.

name: The Chenwei Unveiler

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 or equivalent
  • Storage: 16 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 or equivalent
  • Storage: 16 MB available space

short_description: In 7077 AD, a comet brought the "Purple Cloud Mist" virus to Earth. The virus caused mutations, aggression, and evolution in living beings. Human civilization collapsed overnight. The protagonist starts a journey for an antidote based on an ancient saying.
